description: Flood risk assessment in Bujumbura, Burundi (2024-04-20) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by European Commission, Joint Research Centre. Since April 2021, the waters of Lake Tanganyika have been rising at an alarming rate, reaching levels not seen in 60 years. The Institut géographique du Burundi (IGEBU) has predicted heavy rainfall between March and May 2024, and the forecasts seem accurate as major rainfall is being experienced. Coverage: Burundi. The portal files it under the publisher European Commission, Joint Research Centre. Its tags are Regions and cities, Environment, Copernicus, EMSN190, Flood. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
